name: Gakuen Ou Karen!!
source:
New transfer student Kotaro Tsurugi has somehow gotten himself involved in the very bizarre Royal Club at Kurosunadashima Royal Academy, the grandest school in the world. Heiress to the academy someday, but currently a student, is Karen Kurosunadashima, who rules over the Royal Club and is the catalyst for Kotaro's school life!! "We are the daughter of Kurosunadashima! We are going to be Queen of this school!" Studio Gear presents a "royally" slapstick visual novel comedy.

[Taken from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE139085.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
新转校生剑太郎不知怎么卷入了世界最宏伟学校——黑砂田岛皇家学园中极其古怪的皇家社团。黑砂田岛花恋是学院未来的继承人、目前仍是学生，她统治着皇家社团，也成为剑太郎校园生活的导火索！“我们可是黑砂田岛家的女儿！我们要成为这所学校的女王！”Studio Gear带来一部“皇家”风格的胡闹视觉小说喜剧。

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE139085.html]DLsite[/url]]
